bolts.text: It always seems impossible until it's done.
bolts.author: Nelson Mandela

bolts.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
bolts.author: Steve Jobs

bolts.text: Fall seven times, stand up eight.
bolts.author: Japanese proverb

bolts.text: Whether you think you can or you think you can't — you're right.
bolts.author: Henry Ford

bolts.text: Energy and persistence conquer all things.
bolts.author: Benjamin Franklin

bolts.text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
bolts.author: Theodore Roosevelt

bolts.text: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
bolts.author: Lao Tzu

bolts.text: The best way out is always through.
bolts.author: Robert Frost

bolts.text: Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
bolts.author: Arthur Ashe

bolts.text: I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
bolts.author: Thomas Edison

bolts.text: It does not matter how slowly you go, as long as you do not stop.
bolts.author: Confucius

bolts.text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is a habit.
bolts.author: Aristotle

bolts.text: I am the storm I have been waiting for.
My energy is a current, and today I choose where it flows.
I do not need permission to begin.
Small sparks, repeated daily, become lightning.
I grow at the speed of my own thunder.
Progress counts even when nobody claps.
I trade perfect for started.
My discipline is a gift I hand to my future self.
Today I carry voltage, not doubt.
The heavy thing gets lighter the moment I lift it.
A lightning channel heats the surrounding air to roughly 30,000 °C — about five times hotter than the surface of the Sun.
On average it takes about 66 days for a new behaviour to start feeling automatic — the first two weeks are the loudest.
At rest your body radiates around 100 watts of heat — the same as an old incandescent bulb quietly glowing.
Some bamboo species can grow almost a metre in a single day, without ever seeing the top of themselves.
Astronauts get up to five centimetres taller in orbit, then shrink back once gravity remembers them.
Trees exchange sugar and warning signals through underground fungal networks — a forest is one slow conversation.
Honey found sealed in Egyptian tombs is still edible after more than three thousand years.
The Earth is struck by lightning roughly a hundred times every second. Something is always starting somewhere.
Build the version of you that scares the doubt out of the room.
Momentum is a mood you can manufacture.
Some days the win is simply not quitting.
We accept the love we think we deserve.
bolts.author: Stephen Chbosky

bolts.text: Love does not consist of gazing at each other, but of looking outward together in the same direction.
bolts.author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry

bolts.text: Where there is love there is life.
bolts.author: Mahatma Gandhi

bolts.text: To love and be loved is to feel the sun from both sides.
bolts.author: David Viscott

bolts.text: Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
bolts.author: Lao Tzu

bolts.text: There is no remedy for love but to love more.
bolts.author: Henry David Thoreau

bolts.text: Love recognises no barriers.
bolts.author: Maya Angelou

bolts.text: The best thing to hold onto in life is each other.
bolts.author: Audrey Hepburn

bolts.text: The greatest thing you'll ever learn is just to love and be loved in return.
bolts.author: Eden Ahbez

bolts.text: Tenderness and kindness are not signs of weakness, but manifestations of strength.
bolts.author: Khalil Gibran

bolts.text: I am worthy of a love that feels like calm weather.
I give generously without giving myself away.
I let myself be seen before I am perfect.
My heart is not a fortress; it is a doorway.
I speak kindly to the person in the mirror today.
I attract people who feel like electricity, not like static.
I forgive myself for loving loudly.
The right people will not need convincing.
I choose softness as a form of strength.
Holding the hand of someone you trust measurably lowers your body's stress response to pain.
When close partners sit quietly together, their heart rates and breathing can drift into sync.
In a famous study, four minutes of steady eye contact was enough to raise strangers' feelings of closeness.
Sea otters hold paws while they sleep so the current will not carry them away from each other.
Prairie voles form lifelong pair bonds, and scientists trace the loyalty to oxytocin and vasopressin.
A hug of about twenty seconds is roughly where the body starts releasing oxytocin in earnest.
Albatross pairs can reunite at the same nesting spot year after year, after months alone at sea.
Two currents, one circuit.
Say the kind thing out loud while it still matters.
You can't use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.
bolts.author: Maya Angelou

bolts.text: Every artist was first an amateur.
bolts.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

bolts.text: Art is not what you see, but what you make others see.
bolts.author: Edgar Degas

bolts.text: Have no fear of perfection — you'll never reach it.
bolts.author: Salvador Dalí

bolts.text: The chief enemy of creativity is good sense.
bolts.author: Pablo Picasso

bolts.text: Inspiration exists, but it has to find you working.
bolts.author: Pablo Picasso

bolts.text: Learn the rules like a pro, so you can break them like an artist.
bolts.author: Pablo Picasso

bolts.text: If you hear a voice within you say 'you cannot paint', then by all means paint.
bolts.author: Vincent van Gogh

bolts.text: Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.
bolts.author: Leonardo da Vinci

bolts.text: Creativity takes courage.
bolts.author: Henri Matisse

bolts.text: My first draft is allowed to be terrible; it only has to exist.
Ideas arrive when I show up, not when I feel ready.
I make things because making things makes me.
Curiosity is my compass and boredom is my map.
I am allowed to make something nobody asked for.
Copying is how I learn; combining is how I become original.
Today I finish something small instead of planning something huge.
My taste is ahead of my skill, and that gap is the work.
In one Stanford study, simply walking raised people's creative idea output by around sixty percent.
Salvador Dalí napped holding a key over a metal plate; the clatter woke him at the exact edge of sleep, where the images were.
Beethoven counted out exactly sixty coffee beans for every cup he brewed.
The 'shower effect' has research behind it: mildly distracting tasks help the mind link distant ideas.
Moderate background noise — a café hum — tends to help abstract thinking more than total silence.
Agatha Christie wrote many of her plots while soaking in a bathtub, eating apples.
The word 'inspiration' originally meant to breathe in — creativity was literally something you inhaled.
Make something ugly today. It counts.
Steal the spark, not the shape.
The blank page is not empty. It is loaded.
I am not afraid of death, I just don't want to be there when it happens.
bolts.author: Woody Allen

bolts.text: The road to success is dotted with many tempting parking spaces.
bolts.author: Will Rogers

bolts.text: A day without sunshine is like, you know, night.
bolts.author: Steve Martin

bolts.text: I always wanted to be somebody, but now I realise I should have been more specific.
bolts.author: Lily Tomlin

bolts.text: If you think nobody cares if you're alive, try missing a couple of car payments.
bolts.author: Earl Wilson

bolts.text: Age is something that doesn't matter, unless you are a cheese.
bolts.author: Luis Buñuel

bolts.text: Never put off till tomorrow what may be done the day after tomorrow just as well.
bolts.author: Mark Twain

bolts.text: I have a lot of growing up to do. I realised that the other day inside my fort.
bolts.author: Zach Galifianakis

bolts.text: Everything is funny, as long as it's happening to somebody else.
bolts.author: Will Rogers

bolts.text: I am doing my best, and my best occasionally involves snacks.
Today I will be productive. Tonight I will be horizontal. Both are goals.
I release the need to reply to that message. It has been three weeks. It is folklore now.
I am not procrastinating, I am letting the idea marinate.
My tabs are open because my mind is open.
I contain multitudes, and at least two of them need a nap.
I forgive the past me who scheduled this at 8 a.m.
A group of flamingos is officially called a flamboyance.
Wombat droppings come out cube-shaped, so they don't roll off the rocks the wombat leaves them on.
Sea otters keep a favourite rock in a loose pocket of skin under the arm, like a personal toolkit.
Cows have best friends and become visibly stressed when they are separated from them.
Sloths can take up to a month to digest a single leaf. No notes, honestly. Icon.
A shrimp's heart is located in its head.
Scotland's national animal is the unicorn.
Bananas are berries. Strawberries are not. Botany has been trolling us for centuries.
Octopuses have three hearts, and two of them stop beating when the octopus swims — so it prefers to walk.
Chaos, but make it a lifestyle.
Certified overthinker, part-time genius.
